sources.note: Legacy reasoning effort rules migrated into manifest model rules; evidence follows the legacy reasoning catalog.

MiniMax CLI image generation defaults to response_format=url with a 300-second request timeout; video generation verifies the V1 task, retrieves file metadata by file_id, and downloads file.download_url, while a live CN retrieval returned the exact authorized OSS host recorded by the video output contract.
MiniMax CLI vision describe accepts exactly one image or pre-uploaded file ID and projects the image branch to image_url for the Coding Plan VLM endpoint.
MiniMax CLI maps JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, and HEIF local images to Data URLs and enforces a 50 MiB limit while downloading remote images.
MiniMax synchronous speech supports output_format=url for non-streaming requests; the returned audio URL remains valid for 24 hours and avoids embedding large hex audio in the JSON response.
MiniMax documents response_format structured output only for MiniMax-Text-01; the M2 and M3 conversation models therefore remain explicitly unsupported for native structured output.

MiniMax Code implements managed forced-on reasoning effort selection and validates the M3.1 1,000,000-token context and 128,000-token output contract; the official managed catalog snapshot observed on 2026-09-27 identifies MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview with low, medium, high, xhigh, and max efforts plus image and video input.
